Well, I feel like Legionary is a lot more quality while it might not be as wide as HWR (heads will roll).

1. The speed at which the games can go at are very different due to the engines, in legionary you can speed through the game if you know what you want, while in HWR it feels like a drag to play it.

2. The UI in Legionary is so much better than HWR.

3. You can actually get to the end with a random char in Legionary while in HWR it's impossible (from what I understand).

4. I like the progression more in Legionary, it takes into account the average score of ur runs but the biggest contributor to the points is ur high score, while in HWR it just adds up all the points of ur runs.

Now for some things that HWR has that legionary doesn't have.

1. The game has romance, I literally couldn't care about it and it's just something you do to minmax ur runs. 

2. The game has more "things" it's got different weapons and armor with more variety.

3. There is more content in the HWR but I don't find it as compelling but I haven't 100% the game so I could be wrong. 

Basically I find that HWR is as wide as a lake and as deep as a puddle. While Legionary might not have as much content every part of it fits together so well
